title: TDS return (Q1)
question: What is the Q1 TDS return, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: The TDS return is a quarterly statement of the tax the company deducted and paid over, and from whom. This one covers April to June.
body.simple: A quarterly report of the tax the company held back from salaries and vendor payments.
body.detail: The monthly TDS payments put the money with the government; the quarterly return says whose tax it was. Salaries and other payments are reported in separate statements. Once processed, the credit shows in each employee's and vendor's tax records.
body.why: Employees and vendors only get credit for the tax once the return is filed correctly.

facts.v: Quarterly statement of tax deducted and deposited
Your firm prepares and files it; you approve the figures
A late fee for each day of delay, capped at the tax deducted. A penalty can also apply if it stays unfiled or is filed wrong.
